goals.objective: 分析当前 go-hydaelyn 项目是否存在已经在文档、API、类型、TODO、测试或架构上预留但尚未完成的地方；只做只读审计，不修改生产代码；输出按风险和版本阶段分层的证据化结论。

successCriteria.scenario: CLI evidence: run rg over docs, specs, README and ADRs for reservation language (TODO/TBD/Future/v0.9/v1.0/not implemented/no reference implementation) and save exact matches to .omo/ulw-loop/019e7e21-651f-7eb3-b832-65ef59729449/evidence/C001-doc-roadmap-reservations.txt; PASS when matches are classified into actual unfinished work vs intentional future scope.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019e7e21-651f-7eb3-b832-65ef59729449/evidence/C001-doc-roadmap-reservations.txt | cleanup: no runtime/tmux/browser/ports spawned; explorer agents closed
successCriteria.notes: Doc/roadmap reservation scan captured v0.9 roadmap, v0.8 release deferrals, migration deferrals, ADR reservations.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI evidence: inspect production code and tests for unfinished implementation markers (TODO/FIXME/TBD/not implemented/panic stub/no-op placeholder/unsupported placeholder) excluding vendor and .omo; save exact matches to .omo/ulw-loop/019e7e21-651f-7eb3-b832-65ef59729449/evidence/C002-code-placeholder-reservations.txt; PASS when boundary cases include zero-match packages and generated/tooling directories are excluded.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019e7e21-651f-7eb3-b832-65ef59729449/evidence/C002-code-placeholder-reservations.txt | cleanup: no runtime/tmux/browser/ports spawned; explorer agents closed
successCriteria.notes: Code placeholder scan captured ErrNotImplemented, Recipient no-op, provider capability skips, pack recipe future hook, and false-positive unsupported/no-op cases.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI evidence: run architecture/test/public-contract checks relevant to reserved surfaces (sentrux check_rules/test_gaps, make architecture-check, targeted go test ./api ./agent ./multiagent ./contract/...) and save outputs to .omo/ulw-loop/019e7e21-651f-7eb3-b832-65ef59729449/evidence/C003-architecture-contract-gates.txt; PASS when gates identify whether any reserved surface is an untested or architecture-breaking incomplete area.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019e7e21-651f-7eb3-b832-65ef59729449/evidence/C003-architecture-contract-gates.txt | cleanup: no runtime/tmux/browser/ports spawned; command session exited 0; explorer agents closed; planner agent closed after timeout
successCriteria.notes: Architecture gate passed; targeted tests passed; test_gaps remains low and is evidence of coverage risk, not a failing architecture rule.

goals.evidence: C001/C002/C003 all pass; artifacts under .omo/ulw-loop/019e7e21-651f-7eb3-b832-65ef59729449/evidence; no production code changed
